Read input: rtlpp_04270_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_04270 (
    in1,
    in2,
    sum,
    cout
);
input  in1;
input  in2;
output sum;
output cout;

wire gnd;
wire vcc;
wire unknown;

assign gnd = 1'b0;
assign vcc = 1'b1;
assign unknown = 1'bx;

// Internal wires
wire in1_internal;
wire in2_internal;
wire sum_internal;
wire cout_internal;

// Input buffer logic
assign in1_internal = in1;
assign in2_internal = in2;

// Combinational Logic for Sum and Cout
assign sum_internal = in1_internal ^ in2_internal;
assign cout_internal = in1_internal & in2_internal;

// Output buffer logic
assign sum = sum_internal;
assign cout = cout_internal;

endmodule
